description: Check Point Crypto Core 2.X is a 140-2 Level 1 cryptographic module for Windows platforms, Check Point Pre-Boot Environment and Mac OS X. The module provides cryptographic services accessible in pre-boot mode, kernel mode and user mode on the respective platforms through implementation of platform specific binaries
